description: Get the latest SEO snapshot for your product and each competitor you track: domain rating, organic keyword count, estimated monthly organic traffic, backlinks, referring domains, and top-3/top-10 keyword counts. Optionally include each one's top organic keywords and its latest ranking moves scored against you (keywords that matter: your brand, keywords you both rank for, real gaps).

include_keywords.description: Also return each competitor's top 10 organic keywords by traffic (default false)

include_moves.description: Also return each rival's latest keyword ranking moves scored against your product: headline, significance, suggested action, per-keyword positions and your own position (default false)

name: outmano_get_competitor_seo

recent_moves.description: Only with include_moves, rivals only; null until two snapshots exist

filtered.description: Counts of moves the scorer set aside, by reason

items.description: keyword, kind, bucket, position, previous_position, your_position, vs_you, search_volume, url

relevant.description: True when the moves matter to you

seo.description: Latest reading; null until the first SEO fetch

top_keywords.description: Only with include_keywords; null until a keyword snapshot exists
